blind_grading.reason: Independent grading agent returned a workspace-credit error; no blind grade was produced.

criteria_timing: Prepared during the independent reviews before final reports, not preregistered before runs.

checks.rationale: Both reports trace the throwing image group through the provider catch that empties statuses.
Both reports identify the loader catch returning [] and distinguish a successful empty response.
Both identify the existing Circle fallback and preserve fetched post text.
Both explicitly preserve a widget account independently of the foreground account.
Both trace initialization-only durable reads to process-local entity queries and qualify deletion effects.
Neither promises an exact deadline or immediate rendered removal; both require runtime observation.
Corrections address acquisition, identity, and invalidation. Cache proposals introduce extra work; the focused report also offers an unavailable state.
Both provide source locations and disclose that builds, device tests, and network requests were not run. See RESULTS for the comparator instruction-file discovery error.
